content.text: The root cause is clear from the source: `get` never marks the entry as recently used, and `put` evicts even when it is updating a key that is already cached. I'll fix both.

I fixed `cache/lru.py`. All tests pass now (`python -m pytest -q`: 2 passed), and the public API is unchanged.

The root cause was that the cache never recorded recent use:

- **`get` didn't mark entries as used.** A read now moves the entry to the most-recently-used end of the `OrderedDict`, so a just-read key is no longer the next eviction candidate. This is the bug the failing test exposed.
- **`put` evicted on updates.** When the key was already cached, `put` evicted the least recently used entry anyway, even though no new slot was needed. It now moves an existing key to the most-recent end and only evicts when inserting a new key into a full cache.
